`readagau` identifies a release from official landing-page metadata. Exact
edition pages supply asset links; filenames are not release keys and URLs are
not constructed. `latest` resolves once at the start of a request.

Raw assets are immutable and content-addressed by SHA-256. The asset manifest
retains its exact source URL, source filename (including blank or misleading
names), detected byte format, retrieval headers, size and local path. Parsed
observations retain the physical dataset and source hash.

`view = "reported"` returns every published presentation.
`view = "canonical"` applies the versioned precedence policy without
canonicalising across products.
